spec.description:
ProctorPassive SmartVap 100 is an internal air barrier and
variable vapour control layer designed to control moisture movement and air
leakage on the warm interior side of building envelopes. Manufactured from an
air-tight, spunbonded polyolefin with a functional polymer layer, its
moisture-variable design adapts its vapour resistance according to ambient
humidity. In winter it limits vapour diffusion into cold wall cavities, while in
summer it opens up to permit inward drying, protecting timber framing from mould
and rot.
features:
Variable vapour resistance: adapts permeability based
on relative humidity

Functions as an internal airtight barrier to satisfy
blower door airtightness targets

Limits winter vapour diffusion into external
wall and roof cavities

Allows inward drying in summer when interior humidity
levels reverse

High mechanical strength resistant to tearing and stretching
during installation

Translucent material allows timber stud and insulation
placement visibility

Ideal for Passive House, mass timber, and cold climate
building envelopes
Low Flammability Index compliant with AS 1530.2

install:
Install on the warm
interior side of wall framing or ceiling joists over bulk insulation

Fix
tautly across studs or rafters with staples or clouts at 150mm centres

Ensure
printed side faces inward toward the interior living space

Overlap
consecutive sheets by a minimum of 100mm

Tape all overlaps with an airtight
tape such as Wraptite Tape or DriFlash Tape

Seal membrane securely to
adjoining concrete floors, window frames, and ceilings with compatible
adhesives

Seal all pipe, duct, and electrical cable penetrations with
flexible airtight grommets or tape

Install interior plasterboard or timber
lining over the membrane using battened service cavities
selection_checklist:
Confirm hygrothermal design requires an internal smart
vapour control layer (common in Climate Zones 6, 7, 8)

Verify membrane will
be installed on the interior warm side of bulk insulation

Calculate total
internal wall and ceiling area allowing 100mm overlaps

Ensure airtight
seaming tapes and edge sealants are ordered
limitations:
Internal application only; not for
external weather-facing envelope installation

Do not leave exposed to
interior UV sunlight for longer than 60 days before lining

Must not be
punctured without subsequent airtight taping

Internal moisture control in
Passive House wall and roof assemblies to enable bidirectional seasonal drying

retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorPassive SmartVap 100 is an internal air barrier and variable vapour
control layer (VCL) made from spunbonded polyolefin with a functional polymer
coating. It intelligently adapts its vapour permeability to ambient relative
humidity—acting as a vapour retarder in winter to prevent moisture entering
framing, while opening up in summer to allow safe inward drying. Certified for
Passive House airtightness with a Flammability Index ≤ 5 (AS 1530.2), it
prevents interstitial condensation and mould behind internal linings.
